entries.1c43d9dee5d69ff7: As its basic management philosophy, it has set the goal of “becoming a company kind to people and the environment with coffee at its core.” As its medium- to long-term guideline, it has formulated the “Medium-Term Management Plan 2027” covering the fiscal years ended December 2025 through December 2027, and has set “value management,” stating that by creating, communicating and nurturing value for customers and society together, it will evolve into a company that continues to be chosen. Among the issues to be addressed, it cites strengthening its earnings base through productivity improvement and cost optimization, differentiation through development and proposal of high value-added products, optimization of sales strategies in line with changes in channel structure, reduction of environmental impact and building a sustainable supply chain, and human resource development and human capital management.
entries.20bfcad5fbf5ac3f: A single segment in coffee-related business, consisting of the company and one consolidated subsidiary, Art Coffee Co., Ltd. The company manufactures and sells industrial, business-use and household coffee, processes and sells extracts, and purchases and sells coffee-related foods and merchandise; the subsidiary sells coffee, manufactures and sells food and beverages, and handles import and export. Production is concentrated at the Kanagawa General Plant in Aikawa-machi, Aiko District, Kanagawa Prefecture. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥16,056 million.
